name: Loader
description: A simple, animated loading indicator that displays bouncing dots, ideal for indicating loading states or background processes.
usage: Use for indicating loading states or background processes
Customize dot size (small, medium, large) based on context
Customize color to match your design
Lightweight and performant with Framer Motion
Small dots (8px × 8px) for inline or compact UIs
Large dots (16px × 16px) for prominent loading states
examples:
// Small loader with custom color
<Loader size="sm" color="#4F46E5" />

// Large loader with custom class
<Loader size="lg" className="mx-auto mt-8" />
design: Uses Framer Motion for smooth animations
Each dot is animated with a slight delay for a pleasing staggered effect
Color is applied through inline styles for maximum flexibility
Size variants use Tailwind CSS classes for consistent scaling
Animated bouncing effect with staggered animation
accessibility: The Loader component should be accompanied by appropriate ARIA attributes in the parent context to ensure accessibility for screen readers

props.name: color
props.description: The color of the loader dots

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the loader dots

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the loader container
